name: Cachorrilla (Spain)
description: Divided by a blue diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and yellow below.
history: The arms and the flag of Cachorrilla were approved by the Order of 23 February 1996 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 5 March 1996, after the municipal council's approval on 29 November 1995.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
